title: Edge Parity
scramble: Rw U2 Rw x U2 Rw U2 3Rw' U2 Lw U2 Rw' U2 Rw U2 Rw' U2 Rw'
notes: Single edge appears flipped during edge pairing - occurs in 50% of 5×5 solves
story: Unlike 4×4, odd cubes (5×5, 7×7) don't have OLL/PLL parity. Instead, you may encounter a single flipped edge during the pairing stage. This is because odd cubes have fixed centers.
description: The only parity case on 5×5. A single edge piece needs to be flipped during edge pairing. No OLL or PLL parity exists on odd cubes.
